name: PADS Bronze
title: PADS Bronze Whole-Home Audio Package
description: Entry-level whole-home audio distribution package using Cat5 cabling. Distributes stereo audio from a single music source to multiple rooms via in-wall amplifiers.
detailTitle: PADS Bronze Whole-Home Audio Distribution Package
detailDescription: The PADS Bronze package is an entry-level whole-home audio distribution system that uses standard Cat5 cabling to distribute stereo audio from a single music source to multiple rooms. Each room features an in-wall amplifier with rotary volume control, providing independent zone control throughout the home.
features: Simple whole-home audio distribution over Cat5 cabling
In-wall amplifiers with rotary volume control per room
Single music source distributed to multiple zones
Standard Cat5/Cat5e wiring — easy to install
Up to 330 ft transmission distance per cable run
Upgradeable to PADS Silver and Gold packages
